evidence.curator_note: GENERIC SCHEME, lower (unsaturated / pi-ionized) form of eq 8.43. The book prints the odd-electron ion as AB-C=D with the charge+radical (+.) on the doubly-bonded terminal atom D and a single arrow labelled 'i' to AB+ + .CD; no atoms, m/z or intensities are given. Instantiation chosen by the curator: the pi-ionized propanal radical cation CH3CH2-CH=O(+.) (map 3 = C-of-scheme = carbonyl carbon, map 4 = D = O carrying charge+radical; AB = ethyl, maps 1-2). Inductive (charge-site) cleavage of the CH2-CH sigma bond (bond 2-3) gives the ethyl cation CH3CH2+ (AB+) and the neutral formyl radical .CH=O (.CD), the standard localized radical form with the odd electron on C and the C=O double bond retained. ARC COUNT: the book draws 1 arc (a single full/double-barbed charge-site arrow from the AB-C sigma bond toward the ionized C=D). That single drawn arc is a charge-controlled simplification; move <1> and move <2> are BOTH implicit and neither is literally drawn as a fishhook. Electron balance to a NEUTRAL radical + even-electron cation requires the breaking sigma pair to split homolytically: move <1> routes one sigma electron to C (map 3) to become the odd electron of the formyl radical, and move <2> routes the other sigma electron to O (map 4) to pair the O radical into a lone pair (O goes +. -> neutral); the ethyl fragment leaves with no electrons as AB+. The arrow-checker flags atom 4 as a soft 'lone pair rather than radicals' note, which is exactly this pairing.

No MØD rule is indexed for eq 8.43 (rule_index.json by_equation has no '8.43' entry); nothing to cross-link and no rule_mismatch to report. Encoding is curator-inferred: charge-site inductive cleavage of a pi-ionized carbonyl-type odd-electron ion, giving the alkyl cation and the neutral acyl/formyl radical (the charge-migration counterpart of alpha-cleavage, which would instead keep the charge on the acyl fragment as an acylium).

m/z 29.0386 is the monoisotopic mass of the ethyl cation C2H5+ from the curator's chosen instantiation of the generic AB+ fragment; it is NOT printed on the page. Generic scheme with no printed m/z or intensity, hence status 'inferred', detected=false, no relative_intensity.
